## Hey, this is us 👋

![An illustration showing a variety of differently themed Octocats. Monuments from different cities are indicated in the background like the Space Needle, Berlin Fernsehturm and Transamerica Pyramid.](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/3369400/133268513-5bfe2f93-4402-42c9-a403-81c9e86934b6.jpeg)

Yes, we are building `OrigAdmin` on [origadmin](https://github.com/origadmin), a comprehensive administration solution designed to streamline backend operations and enhance user experience.

### Our Philosophy: From "Doing" to "Done"

In the rapidly evolving landscape of AI-powered development, a common theme emerges: tools that assist in the *process* of creation. They are the digital assistants, the code whisperers, the tireless debuggers—they help you with the "doing".

At `OrigAdmin`, we champion a different paradigm. Our vision isn't just to accelerate your development workflow, but to redefine the destination. We are focused on "done".

Imagine a world where complex backend systems are no longer built brick by brick, but are instead assembled from a rich ecosystem of pre-built, intelligent modules. This is the world `OrigAdmin` is building. Through our powerful plugin architecture, you can instantly integrate sophisticated functionalities. Instead of writing endless lines of code, you simply install a plugin. Instead of complex system design, you make minor, targeted modifications.

This approach transforms your role from a builder of components to an architect of solutions. It frees you to concentrate on what truly matters: the unique business logic and the innovative features that set your project apart. With `OrigAdmin`, you don't just build faster; you start closer to the finish line, achieving a state of "done" with unprecedented speed and elegance.

### 🍿 An interconnected community

At the core of `OrigAdmin` is a commitment to the open source community. We believe in fostering collaboration and innovation, which is why we actively engage with developers from around the globe 🌍 who contribute to our platform.

### 🦦 Contributing to the ecosystem

`OrigAdmin` comprises several key components that work together to deliver a robust management system:

- **[OrigAdmin WebUI](https://github.com/origadmin/webui)**: This is the graphical interface that allows users to interact with the system in a user-friendly manner.
- **[OrigAdmin Toolkit](https://github.com/origadmin/toolkits)**: A collection of shared APIs and utilities that power the interactions between different parts of the system.
- **[OrigAdmin CLI](https://github.com/origadmin/origen)**: A command-line interface tool for developers to manage and automate tasks related to `OrigAdmin`.
- **[OrigAdmin Admin](https://github.com/origadmin/admin)**: The backend management system where administrators can configure settings, manage users, and oversee the operational aspects of the application.
